title: Add grant tracking database schema (4 tables)
description: Create the SQLite schema with four tables (grants, grant_applications, grant_application_events, grant_application_artifacts) and an init script that applies schema.sql. No data migration or site changes in this commit.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/db:init creates an empty SQLite DB with exactly the four tables, foreign keys enabled, and rerunning init succeeds without error.

title: Deploy funding.usecoherence.dev
description: Prepare the copied PGS and Cloudflare deployment configuration for the funding subdomain, deploy the Eleventy build, configure DNS safely, and verify HTTPS.
acceptance_criteria: The funding site is built and uploaded to PGS; Cloudflare has CNAME and _pgs TXT records for funding.usecoherence.dev without changing the usecoherence.dev apex; HTTPS serves the expected site.
close_reason: Built and deployed funding-usecoherence to PGS, created safe Cloudflare records for funding.usecoherence.dev, and verified DNS, TLS, HTTP 200, and deployed content.

title: Integrate grant cockpit data layer
description: Replace the temporary empty tracker data with the grant-cockpit SQLite/repository integration and migrate the required grant data, CLI workflow, and context in a separate phase.
acceptance_criteria: The funding build reads the intended grant records from a maintained data source, generates grant detail pages, and documents the update/deploy workflow without depending on the ignored grant-cockpit directory.

title: Port funding pages from grant cockpit
description: Replace the copied usecoherence.dev content with the funding-specific pages and required styling from the ignored grant-cockpit source, while keeping the source directory untracked.
acceptance_criteria: The Eleventy build presents funding-specific pages rather than the main site duplicate, includes only required assets/styles, builds successfully, and grant-cockpit remains ignored.
close_reason: Ported the Grant Cockpit index and grant detail templates, retained the shared Coherence layout/theme/palettes, added only funding-specific component CSS, removed stale main-site output, deployed, and verified production HTTP responses.
